description: Scrape TikTok posts, profiles, and comment threads without cookies. Paste post URLs or IDs, profile handles, or both.

includeAuthorStats.description: Include follower, following, heart, and video counts in author and authorStats.
includeAuthorStats.title: Include author stats

includeComments.description: In posts/profiles mode, attach a comments array to each post. In comments mode, emit root comment rows (comments mode enables this automatically when both comment toggles are off).
includeComments.title: Include comments

includeHashtags.description: Include the hashtags array extracted from the caption.
includeHashtags.title: Include hashtags

includeMediaUrls.description: Include signed video, cover, music, and slideshow image URLs plus mediaUrlExpiresAt. They typically expire in about 48 hours.
includeMediaUrls.title: Include media URLs

includeMentions.description: Include the mentions array extracted from the caption with text offsets.
includeMentions.title: Include mentions

includeRawFields.description: Include item_control, contents, effectStickers, and stickersOnItem from the detail payload. Legacy includeEffectStickers/includeItemControl/includeContents inputs map here.
includeRawFields.title: Include raw TikTok fields

includeReplies.description: Fetch the reply thread under each root comment and include replies with their parent.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

includeSubtitles.description: Include video.subtitleInfos, video.bitrateInfo, and video.volumeInfo (detail path only).
includeSubtitles.title: Include subtitle and bitrate tracks

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum comments plus replies to keep for each post in comments mode, or to attach to each post when Include comments is on.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post

maxDetail.description: How many posts get the slower page/detail enrichment (caption language, collect/repost counts, video tracks). Remaining posts use the fast embed record. Set to 1 for the smallest daily-test run.
maxDetail.title: Max detail lookups

maxItems.description: Global cap on output rows. Posts mode counts posts; profiles mode counts posts; comments mode counts comments and replies. Status rows do not count.
maxItems.title: Max rows

mode.description: What to scrape: individual posts, a profile's newest posts, or comment threads on posts.
mode.title: Mode

postIds.description: Numeric TikTok post IDs (15-20 digits). Use this instead of, or in addition to, postUrls.
postIds.title: Post IDs

postUrls.description: TikTok video/photo URLs, /v/ share links, embed links, vm.tiktok.com or vt.tiktok.com short links, or bare numeric post IDs. Duplicates are scraped once.
postUrls.title: Post URLs or IDs

profiles.description: TikTok usernames (@handle), profile URLs, or bare handles. Profiles mode returns up to 500 newest posts per profile; comments mode can use them as comment targets.
profiles.title: Profiles

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty to run directly; a proxy is not required. The actor falls back to an Apify datacenter proxy on a block signal.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

validateMediaUrls.description: Check the main media URL with a GET Range request (TikTok's CDN rejects HEAD) and add mediaUrlAccessible. Adds latency.
validateMediaUrls.title: Validate media URLs

title: TikTok Post Scraper Input
